legal.privacy.title: Privacy policy
legal.privacy.section1Body: We collect the account, pet and booking information needed to provide Aleef services and support.
legal.privacy.section2Body: Your information helps us operate services, personalise care and protect the platform.
legal.privacy.section3Body: You can update your profile and communication preferences from your account at any time.
legal.terms.title: Terms of service
legal.terms.section1Body: Use Aleef lawfully, accurately and with care for people and animals in the community.
legal.terms.section2Body: Service availability, prices and cancellation terms are shown before you confirm a booking or order.
legal.terms.section3Body: We may remove content or accounts that put users, pets or the platform at risk.
legal.cookies.title: Cookie policy
legal.cookies.section1Body: Essential cookies keep the site secure and remember the choices required for it to work.
legal.cookies.section2Body: Optional analytics help us understand what to improve; you can control them in your browser.
legal.cookies.section3Body: Most browsers let you review, delete or block cookies through their privacy settings.
legal.refund.title: Refund policy
legal.refund.section1Body: Unopened eligible products can be returned within the stated return window.
legal.refund.section2Body: Cancellation and refund rules for a service are displayed before a booking is confirmed.
legal.refund.section3Body: Contact support with your order or booking reference so our team can help quickly.
